findings.descriptionMarkdown:
**Expected:** the new groups prove the old locations are gone from the *tracked* tree, and `cargo test -p gpux-testkit` (TOOLS-1) passes in any checkout of the merged branch.

**Observed:** `tools/testkit/tests/tools_paths.rs::the_old_tooling_folder_is_gone` asserts `!repo/tooling.exists()` and `tools/testkit/tests/browser_paths.rs::the_project_is_tools_browser` asserts `!repo/tools-node.exists()` on the working copy. `git mv` leaves git-ignored generated content behind, so every existing checkout keeps `tooling/ios/GpuxConformance.xcodeproj/` (XcodeGen output) and `tools-node/node_modules/` after pulling. The owner's main checkout (`/Users/dinko/work-private/projects/RayX/Gpux`) has exactly these ignored leftovers today (plus `benchmark/target*`, `benchmark/Cargo.lock`, `benchmark/ios/GpuxBench.xcodeproj`). Reproduced in this worktree: creating the ignored `tools-node/node_modules/x` and `tooling/ios/GpuxConformance.xcodeproj` (then removing them) makes `cargo test -p gpux-testkit --test browser_paths` fail at browser_paths.rs:58, and `tools_paths` fails the same way. So the testkit package suite fails on the owner's checkout after merge until the leftovers are deleted by hand.

**Repair:** assert absence of tracked content, not of the folder: e.g. `git ls-files -- tooling tools-node` is empty (or that tracked marker files such as `tooling/testkit/Cargo.toml`, `tooling/ios/project.yml`, `tools-node/package.json` do not exist), and leave whole-folder layout checks to the sprint-2 layout guard over tracked files. Optionally have sprint-2 docs (t05) tell existing checkouts to delete the ignored leftovers in `benchmark/`, `tooling/` and `tools-node/`. Rerun `c-tools-paths`, `c-browser-paths` and `c-testkit-package` afterwards, then rerun them once with the ignored leftovers present.

**Expected:** TOOLS-2's new group proves the testkit *uses* `tools/android/AndroidManifest.xml` for lane E, just as it proves `ios build` passes `ios::spec(root)` to XcodeGen.

**Observed:** `tools_paths.rs` checks only the value of `android::manifest(root)` and that the file exists. Nothing asserts that `android::build` passes it to `aapt2 link --manifest`; `android.rs:449` is the only link, and no test catches a hard-coded path or a regression there.

**Repair:** add a test (in `tools_paths.rs`, reusing the `Recording` runner pattern from `tests/android_java.rs::the_java_helper_is_compiled_dexed_and_packaged`) that runs `android::build` on a fake SDK/checkout and asserts the `aapt2-link` invocation's argument after `--manifest` equals `android::manifest(root)`.

Resolved. `.github/workflows/lane-b.yml` runs `merge-reports --reporter html,list ../../blob-reports` from `tools/browser`, which matches the download-artifact `path: blob-reports`. Regression test: `lane_b_merges_the_shard_reports_it_downloaded`.
Resolved. The preserve list (line 13) names `crates/gpux_tests_conformance`, `crates/gpux_tests_benchmark` and all of `tools/` (`testkit`, `perf`, `browser`, `android`, `ios`).

Resolved. The Crate Layout sections of `CLAUDE.md` and `AGENTS.md` are identical and accurate against the tree: `crates/` holds the library crates plus `gpux_tests_*` (conformance publishable; the benchmark is the only standalone, unpublished workspace), and `tools/` holds the testkit and perf Rust workspace crates, browser, and the android and ios shells. `vendor/wgpu` holds the fork. `README.md` and `tools/README.md` use "no consumer depends on them".

Resolved. `packaging/state.md` says all workspace crates share the workspace version and Apache-2.0, and that the standalone `crates/gpux_tests_benchmark` (`0.0.0`, `publish = false`) is exempt and never published. This is consistent with `rules.md` and the manifest.
